protocol_correction.reason: V1 incorrectly called the outer-training-mean OOF vector globally constant. Fold-specific training means vary across folds, so its Spearman is mathematically defined but descriptive only; paired inference remains RMSE-only.

scientific_question: Using only the already frozen MAGE development OOF predictions, what are the paired effects of the two previously unreported feature-arm contrasts, and does the full arm improve RMSE over an outer-training-mean predictor?

development_data.development_reuse_disclosure: All rows and predictions come from the already-used train+dev nested-CV artifact. This audit is not independent confirmation and does not authorize the frozen 33-construct test partition.

feature_arm_interpretation.intrinsic: categorical baseline + intrinsic numeric features; no RCS or local-MFE additions
feature_arm_interpretation.rcs_only: the frozen arm name is retained verbatim, but it contains intrinsic + RCS additions; it is not a pure external-pretrained-model baseline
feature_arm_interpretation.constant_speed_arm: not fitted or inferred; intrinsic is a no-RCS ablation, not proof of a separately implemented constant-speed field

exploratory_comparisons.interpretation: local-MFE increment conditional on intrinsic + RCS

outer_training_mean_baseline.construction: For each seed and outer fold, the arithmetic mean observed_rich of rows whose outer fold differs from the evaluation fold; every evaluation row in that fold receives that mean. No evaluation-fold label contributes to its prediction.

inference.bootstrap_ci: two-sided 95% percentile over construct resampling with replacement
inference.permutation_scheme: independently swap candidate/reference predictions within each construct; two-sided absolute-effect plus-one p value
inference.multiplicity: Holm across five exploratory tests: two feature-arm contrasts times two metrics plus full-minus-outer-train-mean RMSE
inference.sensitivity: point estimates only for all five effects on the two sensitivity seeds; no new resampling family
inference.no_gate_rule: No significance or sign pattern in this post-hoc audit can change DEV_NO_GO_TEST_UNTOUCHED or authorize test, transport, generator training, or a SOTA claim.

technical_contract.report_overall_pass_scope: technical artifact contract only; never a scientific GO
